contentBlocks.text: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੁਹਾਵਰੇ ਸਿੱਖੇ। ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਸਾਹਿਤ ਦੀ ਜਾਣ-ਪਛਾਣ! (Last week you learned idioms. This week: an introduction to Punjabi literature!)

Literature is writing that's created to be shared, remembered, and passed down — not just everyday communication. Punjabi has a rich literary tradition across several forms: ਕਵਿਤਾ (poetry), ਕਹਾਣੀ (story/prose), and forms sung or spoken aloud in community settings. Why do you think a culture's literature matters for keeping its language and stories alive across generations?
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸਾਹਿਤ ਬਾਰੇ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ! (You just learned about literature!) Tomorrow we'll learn about a real traditional Punjabi verse form.

objectives: Define literature as writing created to be shared, remembered, and passed down
Name ਕਵਿਤਾ (poetry) and ਕਹਾਣੀ (story) as two Punjabi literary forms
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review last week's idioms briefly.
2. Introduce the concept of literature and the ਕਵਿਤਾ/ਕਹਾਣੀ vocabulary.
3. Discuss why literature matters for a culture.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's Boli lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: connect to a story or poem the child already knows in any language as a relatable example
Ready for more: ask the child what makes a piece of writing feel memorable enough to be passed down
This opens the course's 'introduction to Punjabi literature' description as a general survey before specific forms tomorrow
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended reflection activity — check that the child gives a genuine reason literature helps preserve language/culture across generations.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'introduction to Punjabi literature' goal, opening this week's thread with a general survey before specific forms.

prompts.prompt: Why does a culture's literature matter for keeping its language and stories alive?
